newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds Metals new CEO gets stock options.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds Metals new CEO gets stock options.

text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said Tuesday the Compensation Committee of its board has granted chief executive Jeremiah J. Sheehan a performance-based stock option on 150,000 shares of the company's common upon assumption of his new post, effective today.
Sheehan succeeds Richard G. Holder, who has retired, the company noted.
It said the option becomes exercisable if by September 30, 1999, the closing price of the stock equals or exceeds $80.25 per share for 30 consecutive days.

Assuming this condition is satisfied, the option may be exercised at any time between August 30, 1997, and March 31, 2000. The exercise price is $53.60 per share, the closing price on the date the option was approved.
